segments.name: Academy
segments.description: Entrepreneur and investment education programs delivered digitally and in person, for adult learners.
segments.evidence: Academy revenue comprises entrepreneur and investment education programs delivered digitally and in-person.

segments.name: School
segments.description: Early childhood and school-based education programs for children, from early learning through middle school.
segments.evidence: School revenue comprises early childhood and school-based education programs.

segments.name: Resorts
segments.description: Hospitality and experiential learning services, including safari lodges and a café, linked to local mentors.
segments.evidence: Resorts revenue comprises hospitality and experiential learning services.

segments.name: Discontinued operations
segments.description: Entities in the process of closure or restructuring, including University of Antelope Valley and Revealed Films.
segments.evidence: Discontinued operations revenue comprises revenue from entities that are in the process of closure or restructuring.

revenueModel.text: Paying students pay for courses they register for, while free students register for free courses.
revenueModel.evidence: This is further divided into Free Students, who have registered for free courses, and Paying Students, who have registered and paid for courses.

changes.text: In 2025 the Group revised its internal reporting structure to present Central, Academy, School, Resorts and Discontinued operations as reportable segments.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Group revised its internal reporting structure and now presents its results across five reportable segments: Central, Academy, School, Resorts, and Discontinued operations.

changes.text: In 2025 Entrepreneur Resorts was reintegrated into the Group through an asset purchase agreement and renamed Genius Resorts.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we reintegrated Entrepreneur Resorts into the Group via an Asset Purchase Agreement, renamed as Genius Resorts, and through the year the Company has continued integrating AI-enabled tools across its learning platforms and internal systems to enhance personalization, efficiency, and user engagement.
